acceptable_changes: Cut the Moran/Charley Wilson staffing detail (optional).
Reduced the receiving-line diplomats to 'the diplomatic corps' and dropped Palmerston's henchmen and Lady Jocelyn (optional).
Cut Oliphant's Piccadilly/Owl aside, the Stevenson comparison, the Stubbs farce, Milnes's 'pretty verses' and ballad titles (optional).
Compressed the Pickering/Moxon/Atalanta penance and kept the Milnes's female worshipper callback because the Hugo anecdote is retained.
Dropped the club seconders' names but kept the 'getting on' irony.
Condensed the Yorkshire sanity contrast and Carlyle's longer reflection; kept the falling idol and the habit of faith.
Kept Thackeray's wrong-house setup to one clause.
Split some long source sentences into shorter ones; the verbatim excerpts were not altered.
review_focus: Lady Palmerston is introduced before Oliphant is said to have been met 'at Lady Palmerston's'.
Thackeray's 1863 death is framed retrospectively as the 'last time'.
The Butler quarrel stays an unresolved puzzle, and Russell's role remains the Minister's belief ('Perhaps he was right').
The Hugo anecdote is placed at the Geneva Conference ten years later; Milnes's dialogue is given its own attributed paragraph.
The footman sequence keeps Handrew/Hanthony before V4.
risks: The word count is estimated, not measured. The text may run somewhat over or under the 3100 target.
The Fryston section may slightly exceed its 729-word budget, while the Butler section is near its budget.
The added bridge 'Later he did penance before "Atalanta in Calydon"' compresses the source's conditional repentance.
Splitting the source's long periodic sentences weakens some of the semicolon-series rhythm named in the voice profile.
summary: Abridgment of 'Foes or Friends (1862)' following the six-section plan: the opening rage and the army impulse, facing friends together with Thackeray, Carlyle and society, Palmerston and Cambridge House, the unresolved Butler quarrel, Fryston, and the Hugo/Landor test with its aftermath. All eight verbatim excerpts are kept.
